overview.description: The YieldMax Memory and Storage Portfolio Option Income ETF (YRAM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed and seeks to generate weekly distributions by pursing options-based strategies on global companies that design and manufacture memory semiconductors and data storage hardware. YRAM was launched on Aug 24, 2026 and is issued by YieldMax.
